summary: Oceanhawk Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option for 2.4 million units at $10.00/unit, generating $24M additional gross proceeds, and the concurrent private placement of 30,000 private placement units at $10.00/unit. Total trust proceeds of $184.92M were deposited. This is a routine SPAC IPO and option exercise disclosure, not a special-situation event. No business combination or target is identified.
